scheme_name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Backward Classes- Uttarakhand
description:
The Post-Matric Scholarship for Backward Classes in Uttarakhand is a significant welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Uttarakhand. 

This scheme was launched in the year 2015. 

It aims to provide financial assistance to students from backward classes who are pursuing post-matriculation education. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to enhance the educational opportunities for students belonging to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and Other Backward Classes. 

The government seeks to ensure that these students can continue their education without financial constraints. 

The scheme covers various levels of education including diploma courses, undergraduate degrees, and postgraduate studies. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is intended to cover tuition fees, maintenance allowances, and other related educational expenses. 

The scholarship amount varies based on the level of education. 

For students enrolled in diploma courses, the scholarship amount is up to INR 10,000 per annum. 

For undergraduate courses, students can receive up to INR 15,000 per annum. 

Postgraduate students can avail of a scholarship of up to INR 20,000 per annum. 

The scheme also provides additional allowances for students with disabilities. 

Students with disabilities can receive an additional INR 2,000 per annum for their educational needs. 

The eligibility criteria for this scholarship are clearly defined. 

Students must belong to the Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, or Other Backward Classes as recognized by the Government of Uttarakhand. 

The annual family income of the applicant must not exceed INR 2.5 lakh. 

Applicants must have secured admission to a recognized post-matriculation course. 

This includes courses in universities, colleges, and polytechnic institutions. 

Students must have a minimum attendance of 75% in their respective courses to be eligible for the scholarship. 

The application process is systematic and requires several steps to be followed. 

Interested candidates must first obtain the application form from the official website of the Uttarakhand government or the respective educational institution. 

The application form must be filled out completely with accurate personal and educational details. 

Candidates are required to submit the following documents along with their application: 

1. A copy of the caste certificate issued by a competent authority. 
2. A copy of the income certificate verifying the family income. 
3. A copy of the admission letter from the educational institution. 
4. A copy of the bank passbook for the scholarship disbursement. 
5. Recent passport-sized photographs. 

Once the application form and documents are ready, they must be submitted to the designated scholarship office in the district. 

The deadline for submitting applications typically falls in the month of August each year. 

However, students are advised to check the official notifications for any changes in deadlines. 

After the submission of applications, the verification process begins. 

The concerned authorities will verify the documents and eligibility of the applicants. 

Once verified, the scholarship amount is disbursed directly into the bank accounts of the eligible students. 

The disbursement of funds is usually done in two installments during the academic year. 

The first installment is typically released in September, while the second installment is released in January. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Social Welfare Department of Uttarakhand. 

The department is responsible for overseeing the entire process from application to disbursement. 

For any queries or assistance, students can contact the Social Welfare Department at their official helpline number: 1800-180-4141. 

Additionally, students can visit the official website of the Uttarakhand government for updates and detailed information. 

The Post-Matric Scholarship for Backward Classes has significantly impacted the educational landscape for backward classes in Uttarakhand. 

According to reports, the scheme has benefitted over 50,000 students since its inception. 

This has led to an increase in enrollment rates among backward class students in higher education institutions. 

The government has allocated a budget of INR 100 crore for this scheme in the financial year 2023-2024. 

This allocation reflects the government’s commitment to supporting the education of backward classes. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to promote social equity and inclusion in education. 

By providing financial support, the government aims to reduce dropout rates among students from economically weaker sections. 

The scheme also encourages students to pursue higher education and improve their career prospects. 

The success of the Post-Matric Scholarship for Backward Classes has prompted discussions about expanding its benefits. 

There are proposals to increase the scholarship amounts and include more courses under its purview. 

The government is also considering extending the eligibility criteria to include students from other marginalized communities. 

Overall, the Post-Matric Scholarship for Backward Classes in Uttarakhand is a vital initiative. 

It plays a crucial role in empowering students from backward classes through education. 

The scheme not only provides financial assistance but also fosters a sense of equality and opportunity. 

By investing in education, the government is working towards building a more inclusive society. 

The ongoing support and development of such schemes are essential for the upliftment of backward classes in Uttarakhand. 

As the scheme continues to evolve, it is expected to adapt to the changing educational landscape and needs of the students. 

The Post-Matric Scholarship for Backward Classes stands as a testament to the government's commitment to education and social justice. 

It is a crucial step towards ensuring that every student has the opportunity to succeed academically. 

The scheme reflects the broader goals of the Indian government to promote education as a fundamental right for all citizens. 

Through initiatives like this, the government aims to create a more equitable society where education is accessible to everyone. 

The Post-Matric Scholarship for Backward Classes is an essential tool in achieving these objectives.
